text.en: A poet describes himself and what true poetry should stand for.

Kaalakkanithan is a memorisation poem by the poet Kannadasan. The unit says that humanity is the clear essence of the way of life of an individual and society, and a good poet is the very grammar of humanity.
A poet's mind says boldly what it thinks right, does not bow to wealth or office, and shares with others. The poem presents the poet as a reckoner of time who speaks truth.
Terms: கவிஞன் (poet), மனிதம் (humanity), துணிவு (courage) and காலம் (time).
